subject: Onsite lead capture: consent language & EU transfer canonicalization
messages:
From: Sienna Gallagher <sienna@marketreach.co>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom@eventsplus.io>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Question on consent language + EU transfer for onsite scans

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for running through the badge-scanner flow yesterday. We have a handful of privacy/security questions from our legal and ops teams before we finalize the scanner export to HubSpot. Can you confirm the following?

1) The exact consent language attendees will see on the kiosk/QR form (we need text to include in our event materials).
2) Whether Redwood can add a canonical consent flag to each lead export (example: consent_status = "granted" / "declined") and the field name you plan to push to HubSpot.
3) How you’re handling transfers outside the EEA — do you rely on SCCs or is there any additional notice text we should show?
4) Retention period for scanned badge metadata vs. full lead profile.

I've attached a small sample (Event_Data_Map.csv) showing the fields the venue expects in the export. Deadline: our privacy review is on Wednesday EOD — is that achievable?

Thanks — appreciate the help.

Sienna
Lead Ops, MarketReach

Attachment: Event_Data_Map.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Sienna Gallagher <sienna@marketreach.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-08T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on consent language + EU transfer for onsite scans

Hi Sienna —

Great questions, thank you. Short answers up front and proposed next steps below.

Summary answers:
- Canonical consent text: we can surface one of two short variants on the kiosk/QR opt-in (see options A/B below).
- Consent flag: yes — we will push a canonical field to HubSpot called "redwood_consent_status" with values "granted" / "declined". We will also include a timestamp field "redwood_consent_ts".
- EU transfers: Redwood uses Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for any transfers outside the EEA. We will show the notice "Data may be processed outside the EEA under SCCs" in the expanded view.
- Retention: badge-scan raw metadata retained for 30 days by default; exported lead profiles kept per your CRM retention, we can tag exports with a retention_policy field.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben, can you confirm the HubSpot API property names and whether we should use a single multi-select or separate fields for consent + mechanism?
2) Lauren, legal sign-off requested on the short text variants below. Once approved I will push the final copy to the kiosk UI and share the hubspot_field_map.xlsx.

Consent text options (short, <200 chars) — please pick one or suggest edits:
A) "I agree Redwood and MarketReach may contact me about event-related content and services. Data may be processed outside the EEA under SCCs."
B) "I consent to being contacted by MarketReach and its partners about event updates. My data may be transferred outside the EEA under SCCs."

If Wednesday EOD is the legal deadline we should be able to get final copy and mapping to you by end of day Tuesday (we’ll need legal sign-off Monday morning). Attaching draft consent wording doc for review.

Thanks,
Irene
Event Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: consent_wording_v1.docx (DOCX, 6KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sienna Gallagher <sienna@marketreach.co>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-08T13:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on consent language + EU transfer for onsite scans

Irene / Sienna — quick mapping note. We should keep the consent flag as one property (redwood_consent_status) and a separate timestamp (redwood_consent_ts). HubSpot suggestions: 
- redwood_consent_status -> custom property (single-line text)
- redwood_consent_ts -> custom property (date-time)
- retention_policy -> multi-line text to mirror venue retention notes

Inline example (CSV friendly):
external_id,first_name,last_name,email,redwood_consent_status,redwood_consent_ts,retention_policy
12345,Marina,Lopez,marina@sample.com,granted,2026-03-27T14:05:00Z,30d_badge_metadata

Question for Sienna: do you need the raw badge id (venue_scan_id) in the export? We currently include it but can drop for privacy reasons.

Ben
Field Capture Engineer
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Sienna Gallagher <sienna@marketreach.co>
Date: 2026-03-09T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on consent language + EU transfer for onsite scans

I reviewed the two short options with legal. Minor edits suggested to make the notice a little clearer for attendees. Final recommended copy (legal-approved):

Recommended short copy (for kiosk checkbox / QR form):
"I consent to being contacted by MarketReach and Redwood Inference about event-related products and services. My data may be processed or transferred outside the EEA under Standard Contractual Clauses."

Suggested checkbox label (single line): "I agree to be contacted about event updates (see details)"
Expanded details link text (hover or tap): "How we use your data — includes transfers and retention"

Retention language for export metadata (for inclusion in export record): "Badge scan metadata retained 30 days; lead profile retained per customer CRM settings."

On SCCs: legal confirms SCCs cover the transfer in our standard T&Cs, no additional consent checkbox needed beyond the expanded notice. If MarketReach requires a separate contractual addendum, please flag and we’ll route to contracts.

Happy to sign off if Ben confirms the HubSpot property names.

Lauren
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Sienna Gallagher <sienna@marketreach.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-09T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Consent text + HubSpot mapping and next steps

Sienna —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Per legal and engineering review, please see the agreed pieces below. We’re ready to push this live to the kiosks and send your HubSpot mapping.

1) Final consent text (to show on QR form + kiosk):
"I consent to being contacted by MarketReach and Redwood Inference about event-related products and services. My data may be processed or transferred outside the EEA under Standard Contractual Clauses."

2) HubSpot mapping (attached): hubspot_field_map.xlsx includes: redwood_consent_status (granted/declined), redwood_consent_ts (ISO datetime), venue_scan_id (optional), retention_policy. Please let Ben know if you want venue_scan_id removed.

3) Retention: badge-scan raw metadata = 30 days (we will not include raw images). Exported lead profiles = managed by your CRM retention config; we will tag exported rows with retention_policy.

4) Transfers: Redwood relies on SCCs. We will surface the short notice in the expanded details on the kiosk. No extra checkbox needed per legal review. If you need an auditable contract (addendum), reply-all and we’ll loop contracts.

Next steps / timeline:
- I will push the new copy to kiosks tonight and run a staging export for you tomorrow morning (Tue 03/10).
- Ben will attach the hubspot_field_map.xlsx in a follow-up (attached).
- If all looks good, MarketReach privacy sign-off by Wed EOD meets your deadline.

DocuSign (if needed): https://docusign.com/placeholder/MR-4521-update

Best,
Irene
Event Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: hubspot_field_map.xlsx (XLSX, 4KB)
